rfq_details.title: Traffic Signs Quote Request - 109 Items
rfq_details.project_name: MUTCD-Compliant Traffic Signs for Michigan Municipal Client

introduction: DEE DAVIS INC, an EDWOSB-certified woman-owned small business based in Troy, Michigan, is seeking competitive bulk pricing for 109 different MUTCD-compliant traffic signs (~2,400 total signs) for a Michigan municipal government client. All signs must meet ASTM Type IV (High Intensity Prismatic) or Type XI (Diamond Grade) reflective standards as specified in the attached Excel file.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: Vendor will provide MUTCD-compliant traffic signs meeting all specifications in attached Excel file. Single or phased delivery to Waterford, Michigan as required.
key_requirements: 109 different sign types (complete list in attached Excel file)
ASTM Type IV (High Intensity Prismatic) reflective sheeting for most items
ASTM Type XI (Diamond Grade Fluorescent Yellow) for specified items
All signs must meet current MUTCD standards
Custom text for select items as specified

items.specifications: ASTM Type IV High Intensity Prismatic, 0.080 aluminum, MUTCD R1-1 compliant, pre-drilled mounting holes
ASTM Type XI Diamond Grade Fluorescent Yellow, black arrow on FY background, reversible left/right
ASTM Type IV, reflective panel for sign posts, 3 inches wide × 60 inches tall (or approved equivalent 3x72)

items.description: Weight Limit (Blank for Custom Tonnage), 24x30, R12-1
items.specifications: ASTM Type IV, blank for custom tonnage designation, 0.080 aluminum
Complete item list with part numbers, descriptions, quantities, sizes, and ASTM specifications provided in attached Excel file: 7790 - PREFABRICATED SIGNS, ANNUAL ESTIMATED QUANTITIES_ITEMS_EN.xls

submission_requirements.title: HOW TO SUBMIT YOUR QUOTE
items: STEP 1: Open attached Excel file 'DEE_DAVIS_INC_TRAFFIC_SIGNS_RFQ_109_ITEMS.xlsx'
STEP 2: Fill in columns for each of the 109 items: Your Part Number, Unit Price, Extended Total, Lead Time, Notes
STEP 3: Provide total freight cost to Waterford, MI 48328 (as separate line item)
STEP 4: Indicate volume discount tiers applied (20+, 40+, 100+ quantities where applicable)
STEP 5: Note any substitutions or approved equivalents for non-standard sizes
STEP 6: Confirm tax exemption applied (Michigan government client - sales tax exempt)
STEP 7: Attach product specifications and MUTCD/ASTM compliance certifications
STEP 8: Email completed Excel + supporting documents to info@deedavis.biz
EMAIL SUBJECT: Quote Response - DDI-2026-007 - Traffic Signs - [Your Company Name]
DEADLINE: February 10, 2026 @ 12:00 PM EST (5 days)
Questions? Contact Dee Davis at 248-376-4550 or info@deedavis.biz
